info.title: RealistikOsu API v1 (legacy)
info.description: The old Ripple-style API. It is kept running for existing bots and tools, but it is no longer maintained. New projects should use v2. Public endpoints work without a token. Endpoints marked with a lock need one, and a token also lets restricted users see themselves. Errors are `{ "code", "message" }` with the HTTP status set to `code`. Send `pls200` to always get HTTP 200, or `callback=name` to get JSONP.

tags.name: osu! API compatible
tags.description: The old osu! API v1 format, where every value is a string. The routes are also available as `/api/v1/get_*`. The `k` key is not checked.

get.summary: Find a user or list users
get.description: With a valid `id` or `name` this returns that one user. Without, it lists users using the list-mode filters. Restricted users are hidden unless you are them or staff.

parameters.description: User ID, or `self` for the token's owner. Give this or `name`.
